englishTranslation: Lotus stem salad with shrimp and pork
atAGlance: Gỏi ngó sen tôm thịt is lotus-stem salad with shrimp and pork, usually with crisp lotus stems, herbs, peanuts, and sweet-tart dressing.
whatItIs: Gỏi ngó sen tôm thịt is lotus-stem salad with shrimp, pork, herbs, peanuts, and a bright fish-sauce-lime dressing. The lotus stems give it a juicy crunch.
howToEnjoy: Toss lightly so the lotus stems stay crisp, then eat with shrimp, pork, herbs, and peanuts in each bite. Add chili only if you want heat over the clean crunch.
howLocalsOrder: Order gỏi ngó sen tôm thịt as a shared salad. Ask for no peanuts, no pork, or less chili before it is dressed.
worthKnowing: In Vietnamese salads, lotus stem is the signature texture here; it is refreshing, crisp, and very different from leafy salad.
goodToKnow: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
travelerCaution: Contains or may contain seafood or shellfish.
